content.text:
I submitted **index 12 (Ag 0.26 / Sb 0.74)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.044%, the highest of the three I measured. All 3 merit measurements are spent; I used 3 of the 5 XRD scans.

- **Structure (XRD):** The Ag-rich end (indices 0 and 5) is mostly metallic silver with some Ag₂O, which is unlikely to act as a photoanode. The Sb-rich side (index 12) matches AgSbO₃ in the pyrochlore structure (similarity 0.80).
- **Merit (EQE):** I measured index 12 and one composition on each side of it:

| Index | Ag / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.40 / 0.60 | 0.013 |
| 12 | 0.26 / 0.74 | 0.044 |
| 19 | 0.13 / 0.87 | 0.011 |

Index 12 was about 3–4 times higher than both neighbours, so the peak is probably close to it. The true best could still be a composition I didn't measure, such as index 10, 11, 14 or 15. With only three measurements I couldn't narrow it further.

The best value is very low in absolute terms. At 2.4 eV illumination, none of these compositions works well as a photoanode.
